# Tender Response — RTL-2026-07
**Visakoivu Oy** to Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds public liability insurance in excess of the required EUR 1,000,000 minimum.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Escalation procedure.** Unresolved faults are escalated to a technical lead if not closed within one working day, and to the service manager if unresolved after 48 hours, with a written status update issued to the client at each stage.

**4.3 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our environmental management arrangements for the duration of the contract, covering waste handling and containment of refrigerants and other regulated substances on site.

**4.4 Building automation.** Our building automation team supports both BACnet and Modbus protocols, and will confirm the specific integration required at each property during mobilisation.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Pricing structure.** Fixed monthly price for scheduled maintenance, corrective work on a time and materials basis at agreed hourly rates.

**5.2 Invoicing.** Monthly invoicing, itemised by property, issued in arrears against completed and verified work.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1** Visakoivu Oy operates a quality management system covering the scheduled and corrective maintenance work described in this tender, with regular internal review of service delivery against the agreed schedule.

Visakoivu Oy is a technical and facility services company based in Jyväskylä, operating across LVI, sähkö, rakennusautomaatio and kiinteistönhoito disciplines, with 180 staff serving public and private clients across the region. We look forward to discussing this proposal and to supporting Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy's properties.
